text: どんな　わざを　おぼえさせるかで　トレーナーの　じつりょくが　とわれます！

structure.jp: どんな　わざを　おぼえさせるかで
トレーナーの　じつりょくが　とわれます！

patterns.name: 〜で (how)
patterns.explanation: で marks the thing that decides or is the means. おぼえさせるかで = 'depending on what you make them learn'.

patterns.name: 〜られる (passive)
patterns.explanation: The passive says something is done to the subject. とわれます = 'is tested'.

patterns.name: 〜させる
patterns.explanation: させる makes someone do something. おぼえさせる = 'make learn, teach'.
